response.justification: Bogdan possesses excellent domain experience in geospatial data (GISCollective) and strong distributed systems background building low-latency, high-throughput microservices. However, his recent tech stack heavily leans on TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than the required Modern C++ or Rust. While he has foundational C++ experience from earlier in his career and a demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, his lack of recent production C++/Rust experience makes him a borderline candidate who would require ramp-up time in the core languages.
strengths: Deep domain expertise in geospatial data processing and GIS platforms (GISCollective, Green Map).
Proven experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems and microservices.
Demonstrated polyglot ability and strong software craftsmanship focus (TDD, CI/CD, automation).
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience in Modern C++ or Rust, which are the primary required technologies.
Most recent roles are heavily focused on full-stack web development (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than low-level data pipelines.
No explicit experience with routing algorithms or navigation guidance solutions, despite strong general GIS background.
